title: A/R Collection: ticked locations survive reload, Back and a shared link
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, location A and location B, with location A's name first in A to Z order.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. In the Location menu, untick location B.
  2. Copy the page address.
  3. Reload the page.
  4. In the Location menu, click "Select all".
  5. Click the browser's Back button.
  6. Open a new browser tab.
  7. Paste the copied address into its address bar.
  8. Press Enter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The report narrows to location A.

Step 2:

  • The address is copied.

Step 3:

  • The report reloads with only location A ticked.

Step 4:

  • Every location is ticked.

Step 5:

  • The report shows only location A ticked again.

Step 6:

  • A new, empty tab opens.

Step 7:

  • The copied address shows in the address bar.

Step 8:

  • The shared link opens the report with only location A ticked.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R10: “The ticked locations are kept in the page address while fewer than all are ticked, so browser Back, a reload and a shared link restore them; a link listing several locations separated by commas is read as those locations. "No locations" is not kept in the address: a reload or shared link opens on All locations, as on Sales By Customer. A link naming every location reads as All locations.”
